title: Zero-free half-planes for Hecke L-functions over number fields
summary: In [Liu26a], varying the length and moment parameters in the cubic-theta argument of [Ope26a] gave the zero-free half-plane $Re(s)>B_{\mathrm{new}}=0.874957019420098946\ldots$ for finite-order Hecke $L$-functions over $\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})$ and for Dirichlet $L$-functions, and its optimality in the specified exponent comparison system. In this paper, we extend the argument to finite-order Hecke $L$-functions over cyclotomic fields containing $μ_{12}$ and, by class-field descent, to every pair $(K,η)$ whose cyclic class field has metabelian normal closure over $\mathbb Q$, including every…
